about: ENGRAM Assist: which hand signal does what. See docs/ASSIST.md before changing it. Signals: open_palm, thumbs_up, thumbs_down, pointing, fist, peace, waving. Actions: stop, approve, cancel, command (needs text), none. Optional on any action but none: say, a short sentence said out loud on the laptop. A signal left out does nothing. At least one signal must stop.
